summary.text: Tim Hanigan is a Republican candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives District 3 (2 seats) in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside Spencer Sommers and against Democrat Erin Rudner.
Hanigan finished second in the June 2, 2026 Republican primary, defeating incumbent Al Novstrup and Kaleb Weis.
